results.evidence: Detached at 6b8dae8 (base 0436a53), npm ci --prefer-offline exit 0. I brought in the original reproducer site/tests/unit/redteam-RT-08-p6-m9-black-provenance.test.ts with git show from worktree-agent-a3775b5da62a67ad5 (untracked, removed afterwards). Command: npx vitest run --project site-unit <reproducer> site/tests/unit/content-m9-black-provenance.test.ts. Result: 2 files, 6 passed (at the gate: 'a general statement with no provenance'). I ran a scratch copy of redteam-RT-08-p6-black-fixed.py on reference/: A2, A3, B3 and D4 each give 0 failures on admissible pairs (2, 6, 2 and 12 failures on other decorations), exit 0. Beat 1 of the built page reads 'A node is black exactly when θ fixes its root, for every real form, verified by computation; ...'. My own oracle check used lie_games admissibility and theta on every X and every symmetry τ with τ^2=1 and τ(X)=X, over 31 finite types of rank at most 8. Of 171 admissible pairs, 0 fail. Of 994 pairs meeting condition 2, 0 fail. The statement fails on 1830 pairs that break condition 2, so the added scope 'for every real form' is needed. Scratch revert 1: I removed ', for every real form, verified by computation' from a scratch copy of the mdx, then restored it (sha256 checked). Result: 3 failed, 3 passed. The reproducer and the adopted test 'its paragraph, or the Seen box that restates it, carries a provenance' both print 'a general statement with no provenance: expected false to be true'. The adopted test 'the sentence itself says which pairs it is true of' prints 'expected ... to match /real forms?|admissible/'. Scratch revert 2: I removed only the scope and kept 'verified by computation'. Only the scope assertion fails. The third test marked 'regression: P6-RT-08-02' runs the engine's theta on the 167 records and checks that on A3 with nodes 1 and 2 black, α1 goes to α2. It is the computation the provenance names and does not read the sentence, so by design it passes on the revert.

I ran NODE_DISABLE_COMPILE_CACHE=1 npm run build: exit 0, links 4003 on 90 pages, 0 problems. Both tests fail, listing the b3 caption 'dim k = 4', the b6 caption 'dim k = 9, dim p = 6' and the b6 question 'plays the word of w_X'.

The original redteam-RT-13-p6-serve, read and m9-reveal-only scripts (git show from worktree-agent-a46277fe7c5321fb3, put in an untracked redteam/ folder and removed afterwards) ran against RELEASE=1 OUT_DIR=<scratch>/rel npm run build (3846 links, 0 problems), served on port 7471 and read with 'nojs 360 800 /modules/m9-real-forms/' (54 blocks). Output: 'b6 ... stated outside the reveal in: M9-q27', 'b7 ... stated outside the reveal in: M9-q31', 'OK', exit 0 (at the gate: 'FAIL: 2 of 2'). Beat 6 now opens 'In the last figure θ sends (0,0,1) to (−1,−1,0).' Beat 7 now opens 'Restricted node 2 and then node 1 give the shadow coordinates (−1,−1).' Oracle checks: L.theta(cartan('A',3), [1], (2,1,0), (0,0,1)) = (-1,-1,0), with stage 1 giving (1,0,0); golden types.A3.positive_roots[0] = (0,0,1), the same path as ROOT13. For e6(-26), restricted_board gives orbits [[1],[6]], restricted Cartan A2 and words of 32 letters; from α6 the coordinates go (0,1), then (0,-1) after restricted node 2, then (-1,-1) after node 1. Scratch reverts of the regression test: R1 (beat 6 opening removed) fails with 'b6: stated outside the reveal, after the prediction block, in: nowhere'. R2 (beat 7 opening removed) fails with 'b7: ... nowhere'. R3 (the sentence 'The answer to the question below is (−1,−1,0).' inserted in beat 5, before b6) fails with 'stated before the prediction block: b6: The answer to the question below is (-1,-1,0)'. The replaced assertion (M9.spec.ts:439, in 'a prediction asks about what is not yet on screen') passes on the fix. On R3 it fails at line 439 ('b6: the prose before the tool', expected not to contain (-1,-1,0)). The older θ/stage/population filter at line 435 misses that sentence. So the new line checks all the text before b6 plus b6's caption, which is stronger than before for that half. The b6 data-panel check and the b7 coordinate-sentence check are unchanged. Only the over-broad 'nowhere in the article' half was dropped, which is what P3-RT-13-01 and P6-A7 allow. I measured the built page with a scratch script: each question sits at the top of its tool, and its stated answer is 2115 px (b6) and 2068 px (b7) below it at 360x800, and 1279 px and 1341 px below it at 1280x800. That is more than one 800 px screen, so the answer is never on screen with its question.

The original redteam-RT-13-p6-dimk.mjs ran on the same release log and build. Output: 'glossary entries naming k or p: dim-k, dim-p (of 106 terms)'; 'sentences that say what k is: M9-q05: On the real form, θ fixes a part 𝔨 and changes the sign of a part 𝔭.'; 'OK', exit 0 (at the gate: FAIL). Mathematics: scratch kp_dims.py takes θ(X) = -X^* and computes exact ranks. It gives sl(2,R) dim 𝔨 1 and dim 𝔭 2, su(2) 3 and 0, su(1,3) 9 and 6. These equal the golden dim_k and dim_p and beat 1's '1 against 3', so 'θ fixes a part 𝔨 and changes the sign of a part 𝔭' is correct. Scratch reverts of the regression test: R1 (the defining sentence removed) fails with 'the first use of 𝔨, beat 1: The two forms differ in real rank, 1 against 0, and in dim 𝔨, 1 against 3.'. R2 (the Term links in beats 4 and 5 removed) fails with 'a later use linked to glossary#dim-k', received 0. R3 (glossary row 87 removed) fails on the glossary ids, received [] where ['dim-k','dim-p'] was expected. Glossary row 87: its definition agrees with the lesson. Its Wildberger and numbers-game columns are empty, as in rows 35 and 64. Its Lie theory column names the Cartan decomposition 𝔨⊕𝔭 and the Cartan involution θ. Its FirstUse points to beat 1 for both terms, as P6-A8 reads first use. These all pass: glossary.test.ts and the other site unit files (7 files, 43 passed); pages.spec 'glossary: one anchor per term'; nojs; formula-scroll on /glossary/; M10.spec; glossary-later-uses; the glossary tests of M7 and M1; M8.spec. aria-labels: only the two formula links carry one, 'dim 𝔨' and 'dim 𝔭 = 6' (the 6 comes from fmt of the golden dim_p). a11y.spec passes for m9-real-forms and glossary. With the labels removed (R1), axe reports link-name (serious) on a[href$='glossary/#dim-k'] and a[href$='glossary/#dim-p']. git merge-tree --write-tree of this branch with worktree-agent-a78dcd48e6b91f4ca merges cleanly (tree 306c868), and the merged glossary holds the m10-glossary changes to rows 35, 36 and 64 as well as row 87.

npm test -w packages/engine at load 27 on 4 processors: 4 failed, 2724 passed of 2728. All four failures are 'Test timed out in 5000ms', in p3b-complete-games, p7-roots-signs, mainthread-fast-paths and satake-coordinates. Rerun alone, the four files give 34 passed. Nothing under packages/ changed since base 0436a53, so the timeouts come from load, not from the fix.

Prose rules: the 283 added lines contain 0 em-dashes and 0 en-dashes, and no .only or .skip. M9 counts 1791 prose words of the 1800 allowed (preview count). 'anatomy of 8.2' and 'at least two predictions and three challenges' pass. scripts/numbers-in-prose.mjs reports nothing for M9. Five files changed. glossary.mdx is the only one outside M9, and decisions/RT-FIX-P6-m9.md records why. No golden value, convention, reference file or contract was touched.

The fixer's request to MERGE about the labels 2 and 1 in beat 7's first sentence: the fixer is right that they should not come from <G>. They are node labels of the restricted board and have no golden value (SPEC 8.4 asks for <G> only for numbers that have one). They are typed as {'2'} and {'1'}, like 'Restricted node {'2'}' in beat 6, and the node-label entry of M9.spec.ts 'numbers in prose' admits them. But the note is not needed: decisions/P6-A7.md 'numbers typed with no golden key' already names the class 'node labels, condition numbers and beat numbers written as {'1'} expressions'. Adding it does no harm.

Minor wording, not a regression: beat 1's 'for every real form, verified by computation' does not say how far the computation goes. The computation behind it covers only the 167 catalogue records (rank at most eight), while beats 3 to 5 do say ('in the catalogue', 'rank at most eight', 'all 167 records'). The statement is true in every rank, because condition 2 gives it. The proposed 'by condition 2', dropped for the word budget, would have said so.

Minor wording: 'On the real form, θ fixes a part 𝔨 ...' comes right after '... a real form whose θ fixes every root is compact', so 'the real form' can be read as the compact one; 'each real form' would be unambiguous. In beat 6, 'In the last figure' means the previous figure. Beats 6 and 7 now open with the answer to the previous beat's prediction. That is the M8 pattern (P5-RT-13-01) and the fragment records it.

Found while testing, not caused by the fix: the postbuild link check (scripts/links.mjs) checks only page paths, not fragment anchors. With row 87 removed and M9 still linking #dim-k and #dim-p, the R3 build printed 'links: 4001 internal links ..., 0 problems'. The new regression test caught the missing row.
